title: The Building of the Temple

questions.question: When did Solomon begin to build the house of the Lord?
options: In the 480th year after Israel came out of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: In the 480th year after Israel came out of Egypt
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 6:1 (ESV): "In the four hundred and eightieth year after the people of Israel came out of the land of Egypt..."

questions.question: What was the interior of the temple lined with?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 6:15 (ESV): "He lined the walls of the house on the inside with boards of cedar."

questions.question: What was the inner sanctuary (Most Holy Place) covered with?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 6:20 (ESV): "...And he overlaid it with pure gold."

questions.question: What were the two cherubim in the inner sanctuary made of?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 6:23 (ESV): "In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olivewood..."

questions.question: How long was the temple in building?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 6:38 (ESV): "...He was seven years in building it."

questions.question: What was unique about the stone used for the temple?
options: It was finished at the quarry, so no hammer or chisel was heard at the temple site
questions.correctAnswer: It was finished at the quarry, so no hammer or chisel was heard at the temple site
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 6:7 (ESV): "When the house was built, it was with stone prepared at the quarry, so that neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron was heard..."

questions.question: What was the length of the house Solomon built?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 6:2 (ESV): "The house that King Solomon built for the LORD was sixty cubits long..."

questions.question: What word from the Lord came to Solomon concerning the house?
options: If you walk in my statutes, I will dwell among the children of Israel
I will give you more gold
It will last forever regardless of sin
questions.correctAnswer: If you walk in my statutes, I will dwell among the children of Israel
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 6:12-13 (ESV): "...if you will walk in my statutes... I will dwell among the children of Israel..."

questions.question: What images were carved on the walls?
options: Cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers
questions.correctAnswer: Cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 6:29 (ESV): "Around all the walls... he carved engraved figures of cherubim and palm trees and open flowers..."

questions.question: In which month was the foundation laid?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 6:37 (ESV): "In the fourth year the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid, in the month of Ziv."

questions.question: In which month was the house finished?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 6:38 (ESV): "And in the eleventh year, in the month of Bul, which is the eighth month, the house was finished..."

questions.question: What was the width of the house?
What material covered the floor of the house?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 6:30 (ESV): "The floor of the house he overlaid with gold..."

questions.question: How many cubits was the wingspan of a single cherub (one wing)?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 6:24 (ESV): "Five cubits was the one wing of the cherub..."

key_verse_text: Concerning this house that you are building, if you will walk in my statutes and obey my rules and keep all my commandments and walk in them, then I will establish my word with you, which I spoke to David your father. (ESV)
